scope: Historical manually inspected reports. Not a live provider connection. GA4 counts cover recorded consented activity, not all visitors.

source.label: Google Search Console · motorjury.com · Web search · consecutive 28-day periods
filters: Search type Web; no country, device, query or page filters

evidenceFlow.title: Read the authoritative property
evidenceFlow.detail: Opened the motorjury.com domain property in the signed-in Google Search Console browser session on 25 October 2026. Performance > Web > Compare last 28 days with previous period. Read property KPI cards. Last data day 23 October 2026.

metricDefinitions.label: Search clicks
metricDefinitions.definition: Property-level Google Web search clicks, not unique people or GA4 sessions.

metricDefinitions.label: Search impressions
metricDefinitions.definition: Property-level Google Web search impressions. Previous period exact value 12,714 was present in the card's accessible text.

metricDefinitions.label: CTR
metricDefinitions.definition: Clicks / impressions × 100. Calculated from exact observed totals; UI rounds to 0.1% and 0.7%.

metricDefinitions.label: Average position
metricDefinitions.definition: Google's aggregate average position for the impressions in each period; changing query mix prevents treating the change as a fixed-keyword ranking decline.

caveats: Search Console query rows omit anonymised searches. Page rows use a different aggregation and must not be summed to recreate property totals.

source.label: Google Analytics 4 · MotorJury property 550922613 · 26 Sep–23 Oct 2026
filters: Traffic acquisition; All Users; custom date range 26 September–23 October 2026

evidenceFlow.title: Verify the correct property
evidenceFlow.detail: Selected MotorJury, property 550922613, from the Analytics account picker. The initial open property belonged to Geniuses.Club and its metrics were excluded.

evidenceFlow.title: Read traffic acquisition
evidenceFlow.detail: Traffic acquisition by Session primary channel group. Read all three channel rows and total: 13 sessions, 9 engaged sessions, 301 events, 69.23% engagement, 2m38s average engagement per session, zero key events and $0 recorded revenue. Aligned dates with Search Console.

metricDefinitions.label: Sessions
metricDefinitions.definition: GA4 recorded sessions, not distinct visitors. Browser visits, internal testing, consent and blockers can affect measurement.

metricDefinitions.label: Engaged sessions
metricDefinitions.definition: GA4 recorded engaged sessions; the sample is only 13 sessions.

caveats: The comparison period displayed zero sessions, while GSC recorded 18 clicks. Historical GA4 coverage is incomplete or inconsistent; do not calculate visitor growth or equate a recorded zero with no actual visitors.
No verified internal-traffic or bot exclusion configuration was available. Recorded traffic is not a verified external-human audience.
GA4 key events and revenue are recorded measurements, not proof that no actions occurred or no money was earned.

source.label: Google Search Console · Page indexing · reported update 19 Oct 2026

evidenceFlow.title: Read indexing summary
evidenceFlow.detail: Overview showed 11,269 indexed and 2,972 not indexed. Page indexing, All known pages, reported last update 19 October 2026. All seven non-indexing reasons read.

evidenceFlow.title: Inspect broken-page examples
evidenceFlow.detail: 404 drilldown showed 383 affected pages. Validation started 2 September, failed 19 September. Examples included the HTTP Volvo XC90 library URL, HTTPS Jiangling Landwind CV9, Mayhem Pegasus and Volga URLs; examples showed crawl dates through 20 October.

metricDefinitions.label: Known indexed URLs
metricDefinitions.definition: Google's reported index inventory at its displayed reporting cutoff; not current live index eligibility and not a visitor metric.

caveats: Noindex, alternate canonicals and redirects can be intentional. Do not label all 2,972 exclusions errors.
The older indexing inventory can include legacy URLs currently noindexed or removed.

source.label: Search Console · Pages comparison · bounded sample sorted by previous impressions
